title: [AI] Fix category_group rule conditions never matching live transactions
issueTitle: [Bug]: "category group" rule condition only works via the rule editor's own Apply actions - fails via "Run rules" and auto-run-on-save
why: The report says a rule with a 'category group' condition does not run when a new transaction in a category of that group is saved, so on the buggy build the rule's notes action never shows in the register; on the fixed build it does.
